detail.longDescription: I tried to follow a JavaScript tutorial. I use Visual Studio Code with "Live Server" extension by Ritwick Dey (because I can't seem to execute it through my browser directly and this particular extension is used in the tutorial). Everything else connected to window (as far as I know), i.e. confirm and alert works as intended, but when I add window.prompt (in any of the following ways): window.prompt("Hi"); prompt("Enter your name: "); let name = window.prompt("What is your name?: "); I get the following error in console window: index.js:1 Uncaught Error: prompt() is not supported. I run my code from a index.js file, which I link to my index.html at the end of the body tag: I cannot find anything about this issue anywhere. When I search for it, I get "prompt is not defined" solutions, which is not the case here. // index.js window.prompt("Hi"); prompt("Enter your name: "); let name = window.prompt("What is your name?: ");
